permissions.summary: Local Kiokuko state and managed project files, optional network-backed Skill or embedding features, and restricted verifier or backup subprocesses.
readPaths: Configured Kiokuko SQLite database and embedding assets
Registered project roots and their repository metadata
Orca traces belonging to the exact native DSH session
Stored native DSH session IDs and histories for startup validation and legacy Kiokuko compatibility
writePaths: Eight bundled managed Skills and references under ~/.agents/skills on enabled plugin load
Existing Kiokuko managed block in startup-directory AGENTS.md; instructions outside the markers are preserved
Configured Kiokuko database and pre-migration backups
DSH run, lease, receipt, retrieval, Deep inputs/artifacts/budgets/reports, post-completion memory-finalization, and embedding state inside that database
.orca/runs and .orca/exports inside verified session workspaces, or the configured Kiokuko data directory
Legacy history compatibility under DSH's native write lease: exact rejected v3 file or validated new v3 generation from retained v0, identical .bak, and disposable validation artifacts
Opt-in Lisp scratch, input snapshots, verified compiled bundle cache, durable operation journal, and approved file changes with host backups
commands: Restricted repository-relative verifier and backup subprocesses when explicitly requested
Opt-in protected SBCL and brokered subprocesses; no implicit runtime installation or VM
externalServices: GitHub or skills.sh for optional Skill discovery and source retrieval
User-configured embedding endpoint when remote embeddings are enabled
DSH-configured model providers for explicitly started Deep planning and its budgeted memory extraction
credentials: Optional user-provided GitHub or embedding credentials; never bundled or persisted by the plugin
failureBoundaries: Repository identity, run identity, lease, revision, and integrity mismatches fail closed
Remote embedding is disabled by default and unavailable services do not become normal success
Ordinary memory finalization failures are retryable; uncertain Deep requests are never automatically resent. Neither can veto completion or session-log export
Orca is configured by default; capture requires a session choice or start command, adds no network transmission, and cannot veto native outcomes
lifecycleEvidence: prepare runs only npm run build
Git installs require the exact pnpm allowBuilds entry for the pinned source archive
Disposable-profile install, Web start, and uninstall evidence is recorded by CI

scripts.clean:dist: node --input-type=module --eval "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.build: npm run clean:dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build-dsh-client.mjs && node scripts/build-history-codecs.mjs && node scripts/build-plugin-entry.mjs
scripts.test:sampledb: npm run build && node --import tsx tests/ci/verify-sample-database.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run publint && npm run pack:check
